_comment: Research-paper-mode parameters for the web tool's interactive analysis path.
_note: These parameters are NOT used by the PAN-PC-11 benchmark pipeline. The benchmark uses reports/implementation/alignment-fusion/frozen-parameters.json.
calibration: tuned on Phase-6 sweep data (P1, C1, C4-light); N1 and N2 PDFs not available during sweep — conservative thresholds chosen to maximise recall in the absence of negative-pair data

thresholdSweepTable.description: Phase-6 real sweep of lexical/semantic/hybrid thresholds on the Phase-0 evaluation fixtures. Run via bun run scripts/threshold-sweep.ts on branch improvements/research-paper-quality. N1 (zhu-2020-e22356.pdf) and N2 (tanreqing-2020-pmc7458256.pdf) were NOT available during this sweep; all columns show n/a for negative-pair metrics.
thresholdSweepTable.metrics_key: c1Alerts = exact-copy control alert count (must stay at max); p1Alerts = real retracted-paper positive-pair alerts (higher is better for recall); c4LightAlerts = light-paraphrase control alerts (higher is better for recall); n1Alerts / n2Alerts = negative-pair alerts (lower is better for precision — unavailable)

choiceRationale.lexical_threshold: 0.5: At this threshold C1 (exact copy) alerts = 5 and P1 (retracted paper) alerts = 4. Raising to 0.6 drops P1 to 2; raising to 0.65 drops P1 to 0 entirely. Without N1/N2 negative-pair PDFs, the conservative choice is to maximise recall on the positive pair rather than chase precision. The 0.5 threshold keeps both C1 and C4-light at their maximum alert counts.
choiceRationale.semantic_threshold: 0.6: Maintains maximum recall on all positive and control pairs (C1=458, P1=206, C4-light=450). Raising to 0.65 drops C1 by 25% and P1 by 39%; raising to the PAN frozen 0.7 halves C1 and drops P1 by 66%. Without N1/N2 negative-pair data to validate that the extra alerts at 0.6 are false positives, it is not safe to raise the threshold. If N1/N2 become available and show high false-positive counts at 0.6, revisit to 0.65.
choiceRationale.hybrid_alpha: 0.25: retained from PAN calibration. Increasing alpha toward 0.35 reduces alert volumes (C1 drops from 418 to 310 at threshold 0.5) which could hurt recall. Decreasing to 0.15 would make the method almost purely semantic, losing the lexical precision contribution. 0.25 is a balanced choice; alpha tuning should be revisited when N1/N2 data are available.
choiceRationale.hybrid_threshold: 0.5: Same reasoning as lexical — maximises recall (C1=418, P1=187, C4-light=409) while there is no negative-pair baseline to justify raising the threshold. At 0.6, P1 drops to 59 (69% reduction); at 0.7, P1 drops to 12 (94% reduction). Conservative without N1/N2.
choiceRationale.n1_n2_note: N1 (zhu-2020-e22356.pdf, PMC7505387) and N2 (tanreqing-2020-pmc7458256.pdf, PMC7458256) PDFs were not available during the Phase-6 sweep. All N1/N2 columns in the sweep table are null. The chosen thresholds are therefore conservative (high sensitivity) pending negative-pair validation. When the PDFs are added to tests/fixtures/papers/, re-run bun run scripts/threshold-sweep.ts and update this file.
